messages:
Kai (ZephyrHealth): Heads up — ZephyrHealth seeing repeated 429s around minute boundaries (:00 and :30) for the last ~2h. Response body: {"error":"rate_limit"}. They say there were no deploys on their side.
Nina (Support): @Kai can you share a short sample of their request pattern (rough RPM/TPM) and whether they use long-lived tokens or refresh per call? Any SDK updates recently?
Kai (ZephyrHealth): They're on SDK v3.2.1. Auth: short-lived token refresh every ~55s. Traffic: webhook fanout — ~20 projects triggering same time, so most token refreshes align. Peak ~800 rpm per org during bursts, no jitter.
Evan (SRE): That pattern screams minute-boundary folding + refresh storm. Our per-tenant RPM default for this plan is 500/min. If many clients refresh at the same second, the token refresh calls + regular calls will spike and hit the bucket.
Priya (Eng): Can we get a quick repro? @Kai try a replay with a tight loop to simulate the fanout. Example: 
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate; sleep 1; done
```
To simulate burstier behavior set `sleep 0.4` or parallelize a few of those processes.
Kai (ZephyrHealth): Ran the replay with sleep 0.2 across 10 parallel processes — reproduced immediately. Logs show repeated lines like: `429 x-request-id=abc123 tenant=zephyr ts=3298743212`.
Nina (Support): Short-term mitigations we can tell the customer: implement exponential backoff with full jitter, cap retries to 3, and respect `Retry-After`. Also recommend token caching for slightly longer (e.g., 5m) if they can, or randomize refresh offset.
Evan (SRE): I'll provision a temporary tenant RPM override while they remediate. Creating RGW-5412 (30m burst window override) and attaching recent request heatmap. Also proposing a server-side leaky-bucket smoothing option (1s smoothing window) we can toggle per-tenant.
Priya (Eng): Long-term SDK changes: add singleflight de-dup for token refreshes, default randomized refresh jitter (0-30s by default), and client-side request folding for identical webhook payloads where feasible. We'll draft a patch for v3.3.0.
Kai (ZephyrHealth): Thanks — applying jitter and caching now. Please apply the override; we'll monitor.
Evan (SRE): Override applied for 30 minutes, monitoring dashboards. Alerts muted for the tenant during the window. :thumbsup:
Nina (Support): I'll follow up with a short runbook to share with Zephyr that includes the curl repro, SDK config flags to change, and recommended retry settings.
bot-alerts: Incident note added to RGW-5412 — tenant override created, metrics snapshot attached.
